title: A Festival in the Village
text:
Every year, people in a small village have a big festival in the summer. The festival is called the Lantern Festival. Families make small lamps with paper and light them at night.

Children wear bright clothes and dance in the square. At the end of the night, everyone eats special bread together. Visitors from other towns come to see the lights.

questions.text: When does the village have its festival?
What do people eat at the end of the night?
Why do families make paper lamps?
options: To use them for the festival
To send them to other towns
To give them to the children

questions.text: How do the visitors probably feel about the festival?

vocabulary.definition: a special event where people celebrate together
people who come to see a place

paragraph_translations: Her yıl, küçük bir köydeki insanlar yazın büyük bir festival yapar. Festivalin adı Fener Festivalidir. Aileler kağıttan küçük lambalar yapar ve geceleri onları yakar.
Çocuklar parlak kıyafetler giyer ve meydanda dans eder. Gecenin sonunda herkes birlikte özel ekmek yer. Diğer kasabalardan gelen ziyaretçiler ışıkları görmeye gelir.
